name: Boars in the Mud
description: Field boars are rooting the yards south of Graymoor Hold. Odda wants eight of them down before the mud takes the fences.

name: Hask the Reeve
description: Hask the Reeve used to collect for the hold. Now he collects for himself, and he stays down longer than a common bandit. End the collection.

name: The Pine Road
description: Road brigands work the north and south of Valdoria as if the kingdom were a purse. Osric wants six of them off the road.

name: Captain Malrek
description: Captain Malrek camps east of Blackpine Tower and calls the pines his. He is named, and he does not come back quickly. Osric wants the title ended.

name: Wolves at the Wall
description: Weald wolves have started watching the north gate of Eldenmoor. Sere wants eight of them back under the trees.

name: Lark the Poacher
description: Lark the Poacher works the north of the Eldenweald and sells what the Amber Hart walks past. Sere wants Lark stopped.

name: The Amber Hart
description: The Amber Hart is seen where the Eldenweald thickens, and then not again for a long while. Queen Ellewynn does not hunt it. Her steward asks you to, and to come back.

name: The Rime Mouth
description: Past Vargan's cleft the stone mouth is open. The first cavern is the Rime Mouth. Kara wants eight rime crawlers down, and word brought to Anwen, who keeps a fire inside.

name: The Shatter Gallery
description: Magister Calden walks the Shatter Gallery under the Mouth. He is not a common sentry, and he stays down longer than one. Anwen wants him ended before the stair north is tried.

name: Ysolde of the Black Ice
description: Ysolde of the Black Ice keeps the vault under the gallery. She is not the shade on Rimeheart Lake, and she is not Vargan Frostfang. End her, then tell Kara at Hearthpass.
reward: The black ice staff, 200 copper, and 1200 experience
